texts.IR_MAENES_intro: Open an authorised orbital station service channel with Colonel Ruiz, controller of the Maenes orbital defence network.
texts.IR_MAENES_defences_answer_1: Ruiz declines to release classified orbital defence details without grounds for investigation.
texts.IR_JANES_defences_answer: Jane's orbital intelligence service suggests contacting the Naval Weapons Establishment at Arance.
texts.IR_NWE_defences_answer_1: NWE recommends a treaty-authorised space demonstration of the Maenes orbital station defence network. Record its actual test outcome.
texts.IR_defences_quest_1: Ruiz authorises the requested space demonstration. Launch from Maenes main orbital station and observe the assigned target drones near the navigation route.
texts.IR_defences_quest_1_alt: Through Maenes orbital services, request and receive authorisation for the first space demonstration. Launch to observe its assigned drones.
texts.IR_gecko_drones: First demonstration: ten assigned unpiloted Gecko test drones are entering the orbital defence field.
texts.IR_drone_success: All ten assigned first-trial drones have been destroyed. Record the test outcome and take the data to NWE.
texts.IR_drone_reply: The first demonstration outcome is recorded. Thank you, Colonel.
texts.IR_defences_quest_2a: NWE receives the demonstration record at Arance's orbital laboratory. The ordinary test alone does not establish a malfunction.
texts.IR_defences_quest_2b: NWE will prepare an electronic challenge pod for a second test. Return after calendar day{deadline}.
texts.IR_defences_quest_3: The zero-price NWE electronic-warfare pod is ready. Issue requires one actual free compatible missile pylon. Use it during the authorised Maenes second trial and obtain a real cannon attack response.
texts.IR_defences_quest_4: Ruiz authorises a second orbital demonstration. Confirm only with the unused assigned pod actually mounted, then launch to the test field.
texts.IR_gecko_drones_2: Second demonstration: ten new assigned test drones are entering the orbital field. The EW pod remains a separate physical deployment.
texts.IR_help_attacked: An assigned challenged cannon has hit your ship. The malfunction is recorded; the emergency shutdown response is starting.
texts.IR_defences_reply_45: Maenes Control is accessing the orbital network shutdown veto. Preserve your ship while the response continues.
texts.IR_defences_reply_20: The orbital network shutdown veto is ready. Shutdown is approaching.
texts.IR_defences_reply_0: Assigned Maenes orbital network shutdown is complete.
texts.IR_defences_quest_5a: At Maenes main orbital station, Ruiz agrees to disclose the network source and software-maintenance personnel records through secure station services.
texts.IR_defences_quest_5b: The orbital defence source/personnel files are sent to Ibanez, NWE and LEXICON. Await the intelligence result after calendar day{deadline}.
texts.IR_defences_quest_6: Ibanez reports matching personnel details for Reinhardt Weiss and Sirius engineer Richard White. Return to Vegedius after the other investigation strands are resolved.
texts.IR_defences_brief_0: Investigate the Maenes orbital station defence network.
texts.IR_defences_brief_1: Request an authorised orbital defence demonstration at Maenes.
texts.IR_defences_brief_1a: Launch to observe the assigned Maenes orbital test drones.
texts.IR_defences_brief_2: Take the first completed demonstration record to NWE at Arance.
texts.IR_defences_brief_3: Return to NWE strictly after calendar day{deadline}.
texts.IR_defences_brief_4: Deploy the assigned EW pod during the Maenes second space demonstration; obtain a real cannon hit and survive or escape its shutdown response.
texts.IR_defences_brief_5: Await the orbital-defence intelligence result strictly after calendar day{deadline}.

project_messages.pod-fit: Second-test preparation requires the actual unused EW pod on a compatible pylon. Your personal equipment and other missions are preserved.
project_messages.pod-context: The pod cannot activate in this location or phase. It remains the same unspent mounted item.
project_messages.no-hit: The network was challenged, but no assigned positive cannon hit has been recorded. Shutdown progress has not started.
project_messages.essential-loss: The experiment has lost an essential unrecoverable item or facility. The parent investigation closes without a successful defences receipt.
